compute_coval_coref_score: compute coreference evaluation metrics including MUC, B-cubed, CEAFe, LEA, and CoNLL score for CoNLL format predictions and references
get_coref_infos_from_lines: get coreference cluster information from key and system CoNLL format lines with options for NP-only, singleton, and nested mention filtering
check_gold_parse_annotation: check if reference lines contain gold parse annotation required for minimum span evaluation mode
compute_score_with_metrics: compute recall, precision, and F1 scores for specified coreference metrics on key and system document lines
get_coval_metric_info: get CoVal metric metadata including description, citation, input schema, and reference URLs
